limits: One memory-only follow-up request; no wall-time or throughput comparison is claimed.
No PyTorch model is loaded in this process, unlike the original paired benchmark.
RSS is sampled every 0.1 seconds and may miss short peaks; process sums can count shared pages more than once.
Ollama API size is a server-reported model allocation, not an independently measured process RSS or whole-machine total.
Process evidence contains only PID, parent PID, executable name and RSS; no command lines or environment values.

cache_reset.mechanism: Explicit unload, verify absence, then model-only load without a prompt
cache_reset.note: KV state is reset; first-request kernel initialization may increase timed Ollama latency.

memory.note: RSS samples, not exact peaks. Every sample rediscovers Ollama roots and their descendants regardless of executable name, including late-started runners. RSS sums can double-count shared pages; Python RSS is separate. Only PID, parent PID, executable name, and RSS evidence is retained for the Ollama tree.
